essence: The dead of any doctrine admitted: immediately after death, solely by raising-power-descent, to the final-sacrament initiation.
Whatever raising-rite was told, all done to the body: full-oblation burning, trust-bearing funeral, net-drawn mantras, breath-moving through heart-throat-forehead — till the corpse trembles.
Joining with supreme Śiva, burning with full oblation; for purified and others — or three-day śrāddha-initiation, monthly, yearly.

Food offered in one hand, virile-formed knowable-power meditated into beast-identity, given to the Lord as enjoyer: ceased knowable-being, become Lord — succeeded or not, rites upon rites for the enjoyer.
Even the liberation-seeker's made-of-That attainment, of the living, daily, like sustained practice.
But the reality-knower needs no funeral-to-śrāddha rite: his death feasts his lineage with consciousness itself.

rasa.dominant: śānta with karuṇa undertow (quiescence carrying compassion)
rasa.justification: Death rites performed without mourning: the dead raised, the deluded convinced, the knower feasted. Compassion without grief, order without haste.

sections.FUNCTION: Admits the dead of every rank, works the whole raising-rite on the body, then exempts the knower.
sections.KEY TERMS: mṛtoddhāra (raising-the-dead as power-act); antyasaṃskāra (final sacrament); śrāddhadīkṣā (oblation-feeding initiation); yojanikā (joining with supreme Śiva); bhoktṛ (enjoyer as the Lord); tanmayībhāva (made-of-That as daily attainment).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Follows the converts chapter: the dead join the lower-ordered as receivable; the knower ends needing nothing.
sections.BOUNDARY: No metaphysics of death argued; the rite is stated, the exemption noted.
sections.EXPLANATION: Death opens every door the living chapters guarded: lower doctrines, lost observances, unperformed expiations — all admitted immediately after dying, by power-descent alone, to the final sacrament. Then the body is worked without remainder: full-oblation burning, a trust-bearing funeral for the deluded, mantras net-drawn in withdrawing order, curbing-piercing-rubbing, breath moved through heart, throat, forehead — till it trembles. Joining made with supreme Śiva, the burning done with full oblation; for the purified and the rest, or else a three-day śrāddha-initiation on the fourth day, monthly, yearly. Food offered in one hand, the virile-formed power meditated into identity with the beast-present knowable — given to the Lord as enjoyer; knowable-being ceased, he is the Lord. Success or not, the desirer gets rites upon rites. Even the liberation-seeker keeps daily made-of-That-ness like sustained practice. But the reality-knower needs none of it: his death is feast-day for his lineage — consciousness-portion filling, lineage all mere consciousness, like knowledge-attainment day while living.
